lock.card.blocked: The lock needs storage that works. Storage is blocked or unavailable in this window, so it cannot be turned on.
lock.card.done.changed: The passphrase was changed. The history did not need to be encrypted again.
lock.card.idle.label: Lock after no use for
lock.card.intro: With the lock on, the saved results and the unfinished assessment are stored encrypted under a passphrase. Someone who gets this browser's files, or a copy of them, sees nothing readable.
lock.card.limits: The lock is not a defence against malware or a malicious browser extension, and it does not replace the device's own screen lock and disk encryption. A forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered by anyone.
lock.card.on: The history on this device is locked with a passphrase. It locks itself after {minutes} without use.
lock.card.title: Lock the history
lock.change.title: Change the passphrase
lock.disable.body: The history on this device will be stored without encryption again. This needs the passphrase.
lock.disable.title: Turn the lock off
lock.enable.backup.fresh: A backup was made {when}. That is recent enough.
lock.enable.backup.none: There is no backup from the last few minutes. Make one now, so that a forgotten passphrase costs nothing.
lock.enable.backup.skip: I understand that without a backup a forgotten passphrase loses my history
lock.enable.backup.title: A backup first
lock.enable.cannot: What it does not do: it does not protect against malware or a malicious browser extension, and it does not replace the device's own screen lock and disk encryption.
lock.enable.failed: The lock could not be turned on, and nothing was changed. Try again.
lock.enable.lost: If the passphrase is forgotten, the history is gone: nobody can recover it, and this app keeps no copy.
lock.enable.title: Turn the lock on
lock.enable.what: What it does: the saved results and the unfinished assessment are encrypted on this device. The language, theme and other settings stay readable, because the lock screen needs them.
lock.outcome.wait: Too many wrong tries just now. Try again in a moment.
lock.outcome.wrong: That is not the current passphrase.
lock.screen.body: Enter the passphrase to open it. Nothing of the history is shown until then.
lock.screen.broken: The lock data on this device is damaged, so nothing can open it. The only way forward is to erase everything on this device.
lock.screen.forgot.body: A forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered by anyone, and this app keeps no copy of it. The only way forward is to erase everything on this device; a backup file made earlier can be restored afterwards.
lock.screen.forgot.title: Forgot it?
lock.screen.label: Passphrase
lock.screen.title: The history on this device is locked

lock.screen.wait.one: Too many wrong tries in a row. The next try is allowed in {n} second.
lock.screen.wait.other: Too many wrong tries in a row. The next try is allowed in {n} seconds.

lock.screen.wait.note: Waiting longer after each wrong try slows down someone at the keyboard. It does not stop someone who has a copy of the data, which is why a long passphrase matters.
lock.screen.wrong: That passphrase did not open it.
